name: Kaori Climax 2 ~Mezase Sekai no Hayase Kaori~
original_name: かおりクライマックス2 ～めざせ世界の早瀬かおり～
source:
Kaori makes her debut as an idol and marries protagonist who is always here to support her. The long struggle finally pays off... until the day she suddenly announces that she wants to conquer USA now. They have to start from scratch now in a different country!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Kaori作为偶像出道，并与始终支持她的主角结婚。漫长的奋斗终于有了回报……直到她突然宣布现在要征服美国。

他们必须在另一个国家从头开始！

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]）
